verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a developer CLI tool like a package manager, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any built-in AI assistant or task-delegation feature in Homebrew. The pack covers only package installation, Brewfile/bundle, taps, bottles, analytics and admin scripting, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
